about_the_game:
With the Slicks Pack, you’ll cruise through the depths in style, with characters like Jaws, Stripes, Emoji, and Salty. These sleek and speedy skins will have you dominating the arena in a snap.

Suit up, squad up, and dive into the action with Tidal Shock. Free to play, never pay to win, this game is all about skill and style. With the Slicks Pack, your speed will be matched only by your swag as you zip through the competition!

Support the Little Guys: Your purchase ensures we, as a small indie team, can keep creating bold, fresh experiences for players like you!
